capabilities: Insert a file's contents as a fenced code block at the cursor
Detect the code language from the file name or extension
Configure custom file-name-to-language mappings in settings
Expand ~ paths and prompt for a language when none is detected
Reject files over 2 MB or 1000 lines to avoid flooding the note
extras: Desktop only (uses Node.js, unavailable on Obsidian Mobile). Listed in community plugins with a 'not yet reviewed by the Obsidian team' notice; automated checks passed but manual review pending.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to paste the contents of an external text file (dotfiles, scripts) into a note as a language-tagged code block.
summary: Command that inserts a text file from your computer into the current note as a fenced code block, with the language detected from the file name.
